dogecoin.text:
It’ll be so funny if Elon Musk talked about another #cryptocurrency on Saturday. 😆

#doge #Dogecoin #ElonMusk

What’s the point of this coin though other than hype? And if there’s use for it, then why doesn’t the team let us in on what that is, like other teams do?

#doge #dogecoin

On this same note, I side-eye #ElonMusk for pushing #doge when he could be pushing more solid projects that won’t be stuck at a dollar or less during its lifetime.

#Dogecoin #cryptocurrencies #SNL
